title: NS Client "Follower"/"Remote User" - "No profile set" warning - Not possible to activate any profile
symptom: After reinstalling NSClient on a new phone, the 'no profile set' error appears and it is impossible to activate any profile. Additionally, no treatments are possible and all buttons for insulin, bolus, etc. are missing, although set up in settings. Only readings of current Nightscout values work.
cause: The issue is related to the fact that NS sends only the last 2 days of data, which can/will be resolved with NSClient v3.
fix: Reactivate (reapply) the profile on the master phone, which caused NSClient to change to the master's profile. Also, the issue can/will be resolved with NSClient v3.
evidence_quote: After reactivating (reaplying) profile on master phone NSClient have changed to master's profile.
